params.description: Optional link to a snapshot image

params.name: severity
params.description: Severity level: low, medium or high

tools.name: buy_cloud_recording_plan
tools.description: Charges the customer's saved card to purchase a cloud video recording subscription for a smart camera. Returns the payment ID and the amount charged.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID with a saved payment method

params.name: camera_id
params.description: ID of the camera the plan applies to

tools.code:
import os

import stripe
from agents import function_tool

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]

PRICE_CENTS_PER_MONTH = 499


@function_tool
def buy_cloud_recording_plan(customer_id: str, camera_id: str, months: int) -> dict:
    amount = PRICE_CENTS_PER_MONTH * months
    customer = stripe.Customer.retrieve(customer_id)
    method = customer["invoice_settings"]["default_payment_method"]
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        payment_method=method,
        off_session=True,
        confirm=True,
        description=f"Cloud recording for camera {camera_id}, {months} months",
        metadata={"camera_id": camera_id, "months": str(months)},
    )
    return {"payment_id": intent["id"], "amount_cents": amount, "status": intent["status"]}

tools.name: email_energy_usage_report
tools.description: Builds a summary of a home's smart plug energy usage for the past week and emails it to the given address. The report lists kilowatt-hours per device.

params.name: home_id
params.description: ID of the home to report on

params.name: recipient
params.description: Email address to send the report to

params.name: days
params.description: Number of days to include in the report

tools.code:
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from email.message import EmailMessage

from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "/var/lib/smarthome/energy.db"
SMTP_HOST = "smtp.homehub.local"
SMTP_PORT = 587
SENDER = "reports@homehub.local"


@tool
def email_energy_usage_report(home_id: str, recipient: str, days: int = 7) -> str:
    if "@" not in recipient:
        return "error: invalid recipient address"
    if days < 1 or days > 90:
        return "error: days must be between 1 and 90"

    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT device_name, SUM(kwh) FROM energy_readings "
            "WHERE home_id = ? AND read_at >= datetime('now', ?) "
            "GROUP BY device_name ORDER BY SUM(kwh) DESC",
            (home_id, f"-{days} days"),
        ).fetchall()

    if not rows:
        return "error: no readings found for that home"

    lines = [f"{name}: {total:.2f} kWh" for name, total in rows]
    total_kwh = sum(t for _, t in rows)
    lines.append(f"Total: {total_kwh:.2f} kWh")

    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["Subject"] = f"Energy usage for the last {days} days"
    msg["From"] = SENDER
    msg["To"] = recipient
    msg.set_content("\n".join(lines))

    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT) as smtp:
        smtp.starttls()
        smtp.send_message(msg)

    return f"report with {len(rows)} devices sent to {recipient}"
